description: Compress vector using TurboQuant (PolarQuant + QJL) algorithm from Google Research (ICLR 2026). Achieves ~3.5x compression with 0.9999+ cosine similarity preservation. Data-oblivious — no calibration needed. Returns base64-encoded compressed data.

compression_ratio.description: Ignored (kept for backward compat). Actual ratio is determined by precision.

method.description: Algorithm: turboquant (PolarQuant+QJL), polarquant (PolarQuant only), qjl (sign-bit only)

precision.description: Bit precision for radius quantization (8=3.5x, 16=2.4x, 32=highest fidelity)

name: zerodb_quantum_compress
